headwords: kinh tế học tân cổ điển

flags.why: The gloss teaches unrestricted avoidance, whereas kiêng kị means avoidance because of taboo, superstition or customary prohibitions.
flags.fix: to avoid something considered taboo or unlucky

flags.why: The example defines the term instead of showing it in use.
flags.fix: Sinh viên tranh luận về mối quan hệ giữa kinh tế và kiến trúc thượng tầng. = The students debate the relationship between the economy and the superstructure.

flags.why: Kiền kiền names a timber tree, especially Hopea pierrei, rather than the entire genus Hopea, as documented by the [IUCN](https://doi.org/10.2305/IUCN.UK.2017-3.RLTS.T33095A2832477.en).
Kiều bào is a formal collective term for compatriots living abroad and needs a register warning.

Kiểu thơm refers to a valued literary work or manuscript, not scented writing paper, as explained in the [Truyện Kiều notes](https://thuviensach.vn/img/pdf/12987-truyen-thuy-kieu-nguyen-du-thuviensach.vn.pdf).
flags.fix: a fine literary work; a treasured book or manuscript
